title: Sandboxed harvest page
description: Walk a cloned sign-in page that never stores or transmits what you type. The goal is to recognize harvest kits, then intercept yourself before a real user would submit.
learningObjectives: Spot a lookalike host in the chrome of a fake portal
Recognize MFA-code collection as adversary-in-the-middle training content
Practice reporting instead of submitting — this app discards all typed secrets

steps.title: Open the sandbox
steps.prompt: Open the simulated portal from this lab, then return. Mark complete when you have seen the intercept banner.

steps.title: Host
steps.prompt: What hostname does the training clone claim in the intercept panel?

steps.title: Attachment lure
steps.prompt: What is the SHA-256 listed for Benefits-Enrollment.iso in the Engine artifacts?

hints: Typed passwords and codes are never written to storage. Only a boolean 'attempt recorded' exists for scoring.
ISO attachments in unsolicited mail are a classic initial-access pattern in awareness training.
